description: This file defines a Perl package 'Coocook::Util' containing helper functions for the Coocook project. It includes utility functions for number formatting, URL name sanitization, and username validation, which are used across the project but are not tied to any specific class or Catalyst framework.

methods.name: significant_digits
methods.description: Formats a number to a string with only 3 significant digits, handling German number format and trimming trailing zeros.

methods.name: url_name
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-safe name by replacing non-word characters with hyphens.

methods.name: url_names_hashref
methods.description: Returns a hashref with URL-safe name and its foldcase version for database updates.

methods.name: username_valid
methods.description: Checks if a username string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
